dish: Sarawak kolo mee (white/red), Kuching laksa, Sibu kampua mee; Taiwanese lu rou fan
address: Happy Hawkers coffeeshop, 671 Edgefield Plains, Punggol, Singapore
w: A Sarawakian-run coffeeshop stall (opened Feb 2023) that is one of the few places in the north-east for springy, shallot-oil kolo mee and a proper Kuching laksa, plus Sibu kampua and braised-pork rice — reviewed by both Seth Lui and Eatbook.

dish: Har cheong chicken bolo burger, mapo tofu fries, chicken chop laksa, Hokkien vongole, gula melaka kopi
w: The Tebing Lane riverside café for Western-Asian mash-ups — prawn-paste chicken in a Hong Kong bolo bun, mala mushroom pasta, chicken-chop laksa — on Daniel Food Diary's Punggol cafés list, Eatbook's 30 best Punggol places and reviewed by Seth Lui and Miss Tam Chiak.

dish: Spicy beef bulgogi rice, chicken jjajangmyeon
w: The Korean container kitchen at the Punggol East container park by Tebing Lane — spicy beef bulgogi rice and jjajangmyeon eaten outdoors by the river; on Eatbook's 30 best Punggol places and TheSmartLocal's container-park guide.

dish: Salted egg crab, black pepper crab, stir-fried lala, Nyonya steamed fish, garlic steamed lobster
address: #01-01/02, The Punggol Settlement, Punggol Point Road, Singapore 828617 (street no. printed as 3 / 500 — resolve at helper)
w: The big crab restaurant at the Punggol Settlement, looking out over Punggol Point Jetty: live seafood cooked zi-char style, with its salted-egg and black-pepper crabs as the calling cards — picked in Honeycombers' and TheSmartLocal's Punggol guides.

dish: Lu rou mian (braised-pork noodles), salted-egg chicken rice, kopi in a retro void-deck setting
address: #02-22 Northshore Plaza I, 407 Northshore Drive, Punggol, Singapore
w: The nostalgic HDB-void-deck eatery (born at Suntec City, reviewed there by Seth Lui, Eatbook and Miss Tam Chiak) in its Punggol branch: braised-pork-rice toppings over QQ noodles and salted-egg chicken rice under letterbox walls and old-school tiles — listed in Eatbook's Northshore Plaza guide and Daniel Food Diary's Punggol cafés.

dish: Ah balling (tang yuan: peanut, sesame, red bean, yam, matcha) in peanut, almond, ginger or longan-red-date soup
address: #02-13 One Punggol Hawker Centre, 1 Punggol Drive, Singapore 828629
w: The fourth outlet of the 1947 Golden Mile glutinous-rice-ball institution (pushcart on Jalan Sultan, Golden Mile from 1975): hand-rolled tang yuan in its signature uncrushed-peanut soup — named in Eatbook's and HungryGoWhere's One Punggol guides (a further outlet now also trades at Punggol Coast, per Women's Weekly).

dish: Signature bak chor mee (dry, $5.80), pork-broth laksa, fishball noodles
address: #02-K55 Punggol Coast Hawker Centre, 84 Punggol Way, Singapore 829911
w: A noodle stall at the new Punggol Coast centre devoted to keeping traditional hawker noodles alive — a well-vinegared bak chor mee and an unusual laksa built on rich pork broth — recommended by Women's Weekly's Punggol Coast guide and profiled by HomeTeamNS.
